article.title: Estée Lauder擴大Microsoft合作，以共用數據支撐美妝AI應用
article.title_en: Estée Lauder expands Microsoft partnership around shared data and AI

article.detail:
Estée Lauder於10月30日宣布擴大與Microsoft的雲端、資料及AI合作，以Unified Data Platform串連品牌、地區、渠道與部門。

合作重點包括消費者體驗、跨部門決策，以及生產力與自動化。

公司表示Copilot已擴展至全球逾14,000名辦公室員工，並正試驗更進階代理及職能流程。

美妝品牌可參考其把消費者與產品資料先接通的方向，評估跨品牌內容、洞察與新品流程的共用基礎。

先找出一個跨品牌重複工序，列清資料擁有人、批准權及成功指標，再規劃小範圍AI導入。

這是合作方公告；員工存取量不代表使用率或成效，未提供可獨立核實的銷售或利潤增長歸因。
article.detail_en:
Estée Lauder announced an expanded Microsoft cloud, data and AI partnership October 30, using its Unified Data Platform to connect brands, regions, channels and functions.

The work covers consumer experiences, cross-functional decisions, productivity and automation.

The company says Copilot access now reaches more than 14,000 office-based employees worldwide, with more advanced agent workflows under experimentation.

Beauty brands can examine the shared consumer and product data needed across brand content, insights and product-development workflows.

Choose one duplicated cross-brand workflow, define data ownership, approvals and success measures, then plan a limited AI implementation.

This is a partner announcement. Access counts do not establish usage or outcomes, and no independently verified sales or margin uplift is attributed to the partnership.
